title: 04 Modes
subtitle: Edit · Preview · Present, and the tools that look like modes — Studio site and Alligators brand
brief: Ruzne mody edit/preview/present atd. — one mode switch in the Share cluster (Edit · Preview · Present, Viewing for people who can only view or comment) with its own glyphs; Preview is the live canvas (DDR-223); Present runs artboards one by one or the whole canvas (DDR-117). Comment, Annotations and Inspect are tools inside Edit and Preview. Drawn on Studio site (a linked web prototype) and Alligators brand (Combine-kampan, 15 artboards incl. print and video).

artboards.label: 1 · The mode switch, and what each mode shows
artboards.note: Edit · Preview · Present (Viewing for read-only) in the Share cluster; a table of what stays and hides across Edit, Preview, Present · Artboards and Present · Canvas.

artboards.label: 2 · Its own glyphs, words and keys
artboards.note: Mode glyphs vs the tool and menu glyphs they must not borrow; the proposed keys (marked once) and the amended Menu › View.

artboards.label: 3 · Edit — set up where a click goes
artboards.note: Selecting a button shows its On click (Go to Pricing) and the link on the canvas; ⌥ measures the gap to a neighbour.

artboards.label: 4 · Edit → Preview, in motion
artboards.note: Three frames at 0 / 40 / 220 ms on --dur-panel and --ease-out: panels fold, edit-only tools slide out, the camera eases onto the same artboard.

artboards.label: 5 · Previewing Homepage
artboards.note: The live canvas: artboards work in place, stickies and pins stay, the toolbar keeps the annotation tools; esc returns to Edit.

artboards.label: 6 · Followed a link to Pricing
artboards.note: A link to another canvas opens it in Preview on the linked artboard; ‹ Homepage goes back; comments still show.

artboards.label: 7 · Preview on a canvas with no links
artboards.note: Combine-kampan: videos play, the web page scrolls in its artboard, you pan across all 15; nothing can be moved.

artboards.label: 8 · Present, and its small menu
artboards.note: Present starts from the selection (⌥⌘↵); the menu offers the start (⇧⌥⌘↵), the whole canvas, presenter view, order and notes, and a live link.

artboards.label: 9 · Present lifts the artboard out of the canvas
artboards.note: Three frames at 0 / 40 / 280 ms: the artboard rises from its slot into full screen; esc sets it back exactly where it was.

artboards.label: 10 · Full screen — 3 of 14
artboards.note: Only the work; → ← and space step in canvas order; L gives a ringed pointer in your presence colour; controls fade.

artboards.label: 11 · A 9:16 video plays inline
artboards.note: Reels plays with sound when its turn comes, pillarboxed; a click pauses; → or space moves on mid-clip.

artboards.label: 12 · Present the canvas — pan freely
artboards.note: Today's Presentation mode kept: no chrome, no pins, no annotations; pan and zoom the artboards where they live; esc returns to the same view.

artboards.label: 13 · Presenter view on the Mac
artboards.note: Now, next, notes and clock on the Mac; the order is drawn as the canvas itself, numbered, with the skipped banner dimmed.

artboards.label: 14 · Watching from a link — and looking back
artboards.note: A cloud viewer followed Tereza, pressed ← and drifted to 5 of 14; the bar offers one action, Catch up.

artboards.label: 15 · Pins, a thread, a mention
artboards.note: C pins a comment; the thread opens beside the pin; Resolve; Open / Mine filters; @ suggests people.

artboards.label: 16 · Someone who may only comment
artboards.note: Can comment: Select, Hand and Comment; the first slot reads Viewing; editing tools and AI hidden, not greyed; Ask to edit. Uniformy-2027's real 16:9 digital boards; the same toolbar as 05 · es-viewer.

artboards.label: 17 · Annotations AI can read
artboards.note: Stickies, arrows, a section and a highlight on their own layer; AI bolds the date the sticky asked for and asks when unsure.

artboards.label: 18 · Inspect “Book a call”
artboards.note: ⌘-click in Preview: the switch stays, an outline (no handles) marks the element; gaps on ⌥; Copy code, Edit ↵, Handoff; CSS under Advanced.

artboards.label: 19 · AI changes the artboard you're clicking through
artboards.note: The artboard under your pointer holds still and AI's new hero lands when you move off; Tablet updates live.

artboards.label: 20 · A view-only link, in a browser
artboards.note: Can view opens in Preview (DDR-223); Viewing is one click away; the menu lists only what a viewer can do.

artboards.label: 21 · Mixed kinds on one screen
artboards.note: Web fills the width and scrolls, posts fit, 9:16 video pillarboxes, print shows at the trim, 16:9 goes edge to edge.

artboards.label: 22 · Presenting with no internet
artboards.note: The missing clip holds its first frame for the audience; presenter view says why and offers Skip.

artboards.label: 23 · What esc does, everywhere
artboards.note: Menus close first; then one step back per mode; switching mid-drag sets the drag down; esc never discards work.
